text: Pellet, ɓen waɗuɓe diina kan pecce-pecce, immorde e Alyahuuda e Annasaara ; tawde ɓe ƴettii yoga e makka ɓe tertii yoga, an Nulaaɗo, a jeyaaka e maɓɓe e huunde, ko o daɗndiiɗo e nde majjere maɓɓe. A fawaaka e maɓɓe si wanaa yottingol, fiyaake maɓɓe ko faade ka Alla. Refti O Humpitoyay ɓe Ñalnde Darngal, ko ɓe laatinoo hiɓe golla aduna, O Yoɓita ɓe ɗum.
